scripts.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:guardrails: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_sync_jobs tests.test_sync_job_acquire_guardrail tests.test_force_refresh_parquet tests.test_summary_activity_type_filter tests.test_sleep_and_hrv_sync tests.test_alembic_migrations -v
scripts.ci:backend: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app/ && .venv/bin/mypy && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -c "from app.database.migrations import assert_single_alembic_head; assert_single_alembic_head()" && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_alembic_migrations.py tests/test_garmin_auth.py tests/test_telegram_notifier.py tests/test_activity_data_validation.py tests/test_metric_catalog_units.py tests/test_garmin_client_sync.py tests/test_coaching_hardening.py tests/test_coaching_v8.py tests/test_coaching_correctness.py tests/test_coaching_v9_operational.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v5.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v7.py -v --tb=short && bash scripts/ci_smoke_api.sh && PYTHONPATH=. SKIP_GARMIN_INIT=true .venv/bin/python -c "from app.main import app; assert app.title"
scripts.test:coaching: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_coaching_hardening.py tests/test_coaching_v8.py tests/test_coaching_correctness.py tests/test_coaching_v9_operational.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v5.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v7.py -v --tb=short
scripts.ci:frontend: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm exec --prefix frontend -- tsc --noEmit && npm run build --prefix frontend
